name: connect
description: Open the live view of a running Threat.Zone sandbox run. Pass `submission_uuid`: the server gets the live-view link from the Public API (`GET /submissions/{uuid}/dynamic/session`) and connects. Only the submitter or a workspace admin gets a link. URL-analysis live sessions are not supported yet. For a WebSocket URL that you already have, pass `url` (ws:// or wss://) or `ws_url`.

submission_uuid.description: UUID of a sandbox (file) submission whose run is in progress

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call (used with submission_uuid)

url.description: Raw ws:// or wss:// VNC WebSocket URL. The scheme is kept as given. Submission UUIDs and submission page URLs are not accepted here: use `submission_uuid`.

ws_url.description: Raw websockify URL when you already have one (e.g. wss://host:9191/?token=...). Use with `ws_cookie` if the endpoint needs a cookie.

ws_cookie.description: Cookie header value for authenticated websockify connections (paired with ws_url)

name: disconnect
description: Disconnect from a VNC session

session_id.description: Session to disconnect (uses active session if omitted)

name: screenshot
description: Capture the current VNC screen as an image

region.description: Capture a specific region (full screen if omitted)

name: send_key
description: Send a keyboard key press. Supports key names (Return, Escape, F1, a), hex keysyms (0xff0d), and modifiers.

modifiers.description: Modifier keys to hold during the key press

name: type_text
description: Type a string of text character by character

name: mouse_click
description: Click the mouse at a specific position

name: mouse_move
description: Move the mouse cursor to a specific position

name: mouse_drag
description: Drag the mouse from one position to another with button held. Supports bezier curves via controlPoints.

controlPoints.description: Bezier control points for curved paths. 0=linear, 1=quadratic, 2=cubic

name: scroll
description: Scroll the mouse wheel at a specific position

name: get_screen_size
description: Get the VNC screen dimensions

name: wait_for_screen_change
description: Wait until the remote screen content changes or timeout

region.description: Watch only a specific screen region

name: file_upload
description: Upload a base64-encoded file to the remote machine via clipboard + shell commands

remotePath.description: Destination file path on the remote machine

name: file_download
description: Download a file from the remote machine as base64 via clipboard + shell commands

remotePath.description: File path on the remote machine to download

name: clipboard_write
description: Send text to the remote machine's clipboard (UTF-8 with Extended Clipboard, Latin-1 fallback)

text.description: Text to place on the remote clipboard

name: device_button
description: Press an Android device button (RTC sessions only)

button.description: Which physical device button to press

name: clipboard_read
description: Read the last clipboard text received from the remote machine

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

description: All available metafield options across all submission types

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

name: tz_config_metafields_sandbox
description: Sandbox-specific metafield options

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

name: tz_config_metafields_static
description: Static analysis metafield options

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

name: tz_config_metafields_cdr
description: CDR metafield options

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

name: tz_config_metafields_url
description: URL analysis metafield options

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

name: tz_config_metafields_open_in_browser

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

name: tz_network_configs_list

name: tz_submissions_list
description: List submissions in your workspace with rich filtering. Returns paginated `{ items, total, page, limit, totalPages }`. Does NOT auto-paginate — call again with `page: N` to retrieve subsequent pages. Common filters: level (threat verdict), type (file/url), sha256, filename (partial), date range, private flag, tags.

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

level.description: Filter by threat level (can specify multiple)

sha256.description: Search by SHA256 hash (exact or prefix match)

private.description: true = private only, false = public only

tags.description: Filter by tags (submissions matching any tag)

name: tz_submission_get
description: Get full submission detail by UUID: file metadata, hashes, verdict level, all attached reports (dynamic/static/cdr/url_analysis) with status + score, indicator rollup, and matched MITRE ATT&CK techniques. Returns SubmissionInfoDto.

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

name: tz_submission_search_sha256
description: Find submissions matching the exact SHA256 hash (across your workspace + public submissions from other workspaces), in reverse creation order. Returns `SubmissionInfoDto[]` (flat array — this endpoint does NOT paginate).

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

name: tz_submission_summary
description: High-level submission verdict rollup: overall analysis status, per-module score and verdict counts, indicator level rollup, and matched MITRE technique count.

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

name: tz_submission_indicators
description: Behavioural detection indicators from dynamic analysis, paginated. Returns `{ items, total, page, limit, totalPages }` — does NOT auto-paginate.

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

attackCode.description: Filter by MITRE ATT&CK technique code (e.g. T1055)

name: tz_submission_iocs
description: Indicators of Compromise extracted from analysis: IPs, domains, URLs, hashes, registry keys, file paths, etc. Paginated `{ items, total, page, limit, totalPages }` — does NOT auto-paginate.

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

name: tz_submission_yara_rules
description: YARA rule hits during analysis. Paginated — does NOT auto-paginate.

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

name: tz_submission_artifacts
description: Full artifact list for the submission: original sample, dropped files, memory dumps, PCAPs, generated YARA rules, and CDR-sanitized variants. NOT paginated — single response with all artifacts.

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

name: tz_submission_mitre
description: MITRE ATT&CK technique mappings observed during dynamic analysis. Returns an empty techniques array if none mapped.

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

name: tz_submission_extracted_configs
description: Extracted malware configuration data (C2 endpoints, encryption keys, family-specific config) parsed by family-aware extractors.

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

name: tz_submission_eml_analysis
description: EML/MSG email analysis results: headers, attachments, embedded URLs, sender reputation. Returns 409 DYNAMIC_REPORT_UNAVAILABLE for non-email submissions.

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

name: tz_submission_processes
description: Flat process list captured during dynamic analysis: PID, parent PID, image path, command line, lifetime.

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

name: tz_submission_process_tree
description: Process spawn tree (parent–child relationships) captured during dynamic analysis.

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

name: tz_submission_behaviours
description: Behaviour events captured during dynamic analysis (file/registry/network/process/mutex). Paginated — does NOT auto-paginate.

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

limit.description: Items per page (default 100). The API has no explicit max — large pages are OK.

type.description: Filter by event type (free-form: registry, file, network, process, mutex, …)

name: tz_submission_syscalls
description: Raw syscall trace from dynamic analysis. Paginated with default `limit=500` — does NOT auto-paginate.

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

limit.description: Items per page (default 500). Large per-page sizes are typical.

name: tz_submission_static_scan
description: Static analysis scan results per artifact: PE info, embedded strings, sections, imports/exports, signatures.

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

name: tz_submission_cdr
description: CDR (Content Disarm & Reconstruction) analysis metadata: threat level, disarmed element counts, per-element details. To download the sanitized CDR output FILE use tz_download_cdr instead (Task 10).

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

name: tz_submission_signature_check
description: Code-signing signature verification per artifact: signer info, certificate chain, validity, and trust level.

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

name: tz_network_summary
description: Network activity summary captured during dynamic analysis: per-protocol counts (DNS, HTTP, TCP, UDP) and threat detection rollup.

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

name: tz_network_dns
description: DNS queries observed during dynamic analysis (query, response, type). Uses `limit`/`skip` offset pagination — NOT `page`/`limit`. Pass `skip: N` to advance through results.

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

skip.description: Number of results to skip (for offset pagination)

name: tz_network_http
description: HTTP request endpoints observed during dynamic analysis (method, URL, status, host). Uses `limit`/`skip` offset pagination — NOT `page`/`limit`. Pass `skip: N` to advance through results.

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

skip.description: Number of results to skip (for offset pagination)

name: tz_network_tcp
description: TCP connections observed during dynamic analysis (source IP/port, destination IP/port, byte counts). Uses `limit`/`skip` offset pagination — NOT `page`/`limit`. Pass `skip: N` to advance through results.

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

skip.description: Number of results to skip (for offset pagination)

name: tz_network_udp
description: UDP connections observed during dynamic analysis (source IP/port, destination IP/port, byte counts). Uses `limit`/`skip` offset pagination — NOT `page`/`limit`. Pass `skip: N` to advance through results.

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

skip.description: Number of results to skip (for offset pagination)

name: tz_network_threats
description: Suricata-style network threat detections from dynamic analysis (signature, severity, src/dst). Uses `limit`/`skip` offset pagination — NOT `page`/`limit`. Pass `skip: N` to advance through results.

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

skip.description: Number of results to skip (for offset pagination)

name: tz_submission_url_analysis
description: Full URL analysis report (page screenshot reference, certificate, redirect chain, threat verdict). Returns 409 URL_ANALYSIS_REPORT_UNAVAILABLE for non-URL submissions or incomplete analyses. Check `tz_submission_get` `type` field first to confirm the submission is `url`.

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

name: tz_submission_media_list
description: List media files (screenshots, videos) captured during dynamic analysis. Use `tz_download_media` (Task 11) to fetch individual files as base64.

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

name: tz_download_sample
description: Download the original submission sample as a password-protected ZIP. The ZIP password is `infected` (industry standard for malware sandboxing). Returns base64 for files up to 25 MB; pass save_to with an absolute path for larger files.

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

save_to.description: Absolute filesystem path to write the file to disk; if omitted returns base64 (max 25 MB)

name: tz_download_artifact
description: Download a specific artifact (dropped file, memory dump, etc.) by its MongoDB ObjectId. Get the artifact_id from tz_submission_artifacts. Returns base64 for files up to 25 MB; pass save_to for larger files.

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

save_to.description: Absolute filesystem path to write the file to disk; if omitted returns base64 (max 25 MB)

name: tz_download_pcap
description: Download the network packet capture (PCAP) from dynamic analysis. PCAPs can be very large for long analyses — recommend passing save_to with an absolute path.

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

save_to.description: Absolute filesystem path to write the file to disk; if omitted returns base64 (max 25 MB)

name: tz_download_yara_rule
description: Download the auto-generated YARA rule file produced from the analysis. Small text payload — typically returned inline as base64.

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

save_to.description: Absolute filesystem path to write the file to disk; if omitted returns base64 (max 25 MB)

name: tz_download_html_report
description: Download the full HTML analysis report (rendered, ready to share). Useful for archival or human review.

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

save_to.description: Absolute filesystem path to write the file to disk; if omitted returns base64 (max 25 MB)

name: tz_download_cdr
description: Download the CDR (Content Disarm & Reconstruction) sanitized output file — the reconstructed safe version of the input document. To get the CDR analysis metadata report (threat level, disarmed elements), use tz_submission_cdr instead.

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

save_to.description: Absolute filesystem path to write the file to disk; if omitted returns base64 (max 25 MB)

name: tz_download_screenshot
description: Download the URL analysis screenshot as PNG. Returns 409 URL_ANALYSIS_REPORT_UNAVAILABLE for non-URL submissions. For sandbox/open-in-browser media (multiple screenshots/videos), use tz_download_media instead.

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

save_to.description: Absolute filesystem path to write the file to disk; if omitted returns base64 (max 25 MB)

name: tz_download_media
description: Download a specific media file (screenshot or video clip) captured during dynamic analysis by its file_id. Get the file_id from tz_submission_media_list. Returns base64 for files up to 25 MB; pass save_to for larger files.

api_token.description: Override THREATZONE_API_TOKEN env var for this call

save_to.description: Absolute filesystem path to write the file to disk; if omitted returns base64 (max 25 MB)

name: tz_submit_sandbox
description: Create a sandbox analysis submission (full static + dynamic). Consumes one daily submission slot from your plan. Returns the submission UUID and message — call tz_submission_get with the UUID to poll status.

file_path.description: Absolute path (or ~/relative) to a file on the MCP server host. Preferred over file_base64 — avoids tool-call argument size limits. Exactly one of file_path or file_base64 must be set.

file_base64.description: Base64-encoded file content. Use only for small files (<~30 KB) or when file_path is unavailable. Larger payloads will time out the tool channel — use file_path instead.

filename.description: Original filename including extension. Required when using file_base64; inferred from file_path if omitted.

environment.description: Sandbox OS environment key (e.g. w10_x64). Use tz_config_environments to discover available keys.

metafields.description: Plan-dependent key/value pairs. Use tz_config_metafields_sandbox to discover.

private.description: Make submission visible only to your workspace (default false)

entrypoint.description: For archive files: path inside the archive to execute (e.g. "malware.exe", "folder/script.js")

networkConfig.description: MongoDB ObjectId of a network config from tz_network_configs_list

name: tz_submit_static
description: Create a static-only analysis submission. Faster than sandbox (no dynamic execution). Returns the submission UUID and message — poll with tz_submission_get.

file_path.description: Absolute path (or ~/relative) to a file on the MCP server host. Preferred over file_base64 — avoids tool-call argument size limits. Exactly one of file_path or file_base64 must be set.

file_base64.description: Base64-encoded file content. Use only for small files (<~30 KB) or when file_path is unavailable. Larger payloads will time out the tool channel — use file_path instead.

filename.description: Original filename including extension. Required when using file_base64; inferred from file_path if omitted.

private.description: Make submission visible only to your workspace (default false)

entrypoint.description: For archive files: path inside the archive to execute (e.g. "malware.exe", "folder/script.js")

name: tz_submit_cdr
description: Create a CDR (Content Disarm & Reconstruction) submission. The output is a sanitized version of the input document with active content removed. Returns the submission UUID — poll with tz_submission_get and download the sanitized file via tz_download_cdr.

file_path.description: Absolute path (or ~/relative) to a file on the MCP server host. Preferred over file_base64 — avoids tool-call argument size limits. Exactly one of file_path or file_base64 must be set.

file_base64.description: Base64-encoded file content. Use only for small files (<~30 KB) or when file_path is unavailable. Larger payloads will time out the tool channel — use file_path instead.

filename.description: Original filename including extension. Required when using file_base64; inferred from file_path if omitted.

private.description: Make submission visible only to your workspace (default false)

entrypoint.description: For archive files: path inside the archive to extract and process

name: tz_submit_url
description: Create a URL analysis submission. The crawler fetches the URL, captures screenshot, follows redirects, checks certs and threat lists. Only submit URLs you have authorisation to analyse.

url.description: Absolute URL to analyse (HTTP/HTTPS). Shortened URLs are auto-expanded and followed.

private.description: Make submission visible only to your workspace (default false)

name: tz_submit_open_in_browser
description: Create an "open in browser" submission. The URL becomes the entrypoint for a sandboxed browser session — useful for credential-harvesting kits and exploit pages. Returns the submission UUID — poll with tz_submission_get.

url.description: Absolute URL to open inside the sandboxed browser

private.description: Make submission visible only to your workspace (default false)
